sourceFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodName: Benthic macroinvertebrate kick net sample in current
sourceFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Hold net opening facing up-current; position net securely on stream bottom; avoid large rocks/debris. Visually define square quadrat up-current from net, one net-width square (0.26 m2). Check quadrat for heavy organisms; place in net. Rub large rocks w/ hands/small brush to wash organisms into net. Vigorously stir/kick substrate remaining w/in quadrat to 10 cm depth for 30 seconds. Remove net w/ quick upstream motion to wash organisms to back of net. Place contents in compsite bucket. Repeat.
sourceFields.SamplePreparationMethod/MethodDescriptio: Dump contents of composite bucket (current and slack water samples) into 0.3-m diameter 500-um mesh sieve; wash sample gently (no nozzle) using onboard washdown hose. Gravel, large organic particles, and macrophytes should be thoroughly washed, inspected for clinging organisms and discarded. Transfer washed composite sample to 500-mL jar using wide-bore funnel; wash bottle w/ minimal water. Fill jar 1/3 full; top w/10% carbonate-buffered formalin (pH10) and concentrated rose bengal solution.
sourceFields.ChemicalPreservativeUsedName: 10% carbonate-buffered formalin (pH10); top w/concentrated rose bengal solution.
sourceFields.SampleTransportStorageDescription: Store the preserved sample upright in a secondary container until transport or shipment to the laboratory.
